description: Add, remove or replace the tags on one frame of an image asset (an animation, edit or part), e.g. to mark which clip is 'idle' or 'final'. 8-way rotation frames cannot be tagged: their tags are the facings the animation presets rely on. Free.

id.description: Asset ID (from list_assets / get_asset or a previous result)

mode.description: add = keep existing tags and add these, remove = drop these, replace = set exactly these

tags.description: Tags, e.g. ['player', 'level-1']. Case-insensitive duplicates are merged

name: tag_frame
